tasks.subject: Phase 1: Core/Value + proven set equality
tasks.description: Port Apalache.Types.Value to Core/Value.lean per §5.1: ITF Value (VInt Int | VBool | VStr | VSet (List Value) | VSeq | VTuple | VRecord | VMap | VVariant | VUnserializable | VNull), keeping the list-of-elements VSet representation. Define setEq as a defined relation with a Decidable instance and prove the §6.1 lemma: setEq xs ys ↔ ∀ v, v ∈ xs ↔ v ∈ ys. Use a provably extensional finite map (tree/assoc map, not HashMap — doc §9.3). Port filterMeta/isMetaKey (drops keys #*, action_taken, parameters). No IO.
tasks.output: Core/Value.lean complete: Value inductive (11 ctors, list-based vset/vrecord/vmap), extensional ValueMap (assoc list), valEq decision procedure with machine-checked refl/symm/trans, setEq §6.1 law (setEq ↔ ∀v, setMem v xs ↔ setMem v ys) + Decidable via setEqBool, filterMeta/isMetaKey. lake build green, zero errors/sorries.

tasks.subject: Core/Resource lifecycle model + §6.5 theorems
tasks.description: Model the Resource ownership protocol abstractly in Core/Resource.lean (no IORef): a resource is a token in {Live, Delivered, Released, ReleaseFailed} × {Owned, Borrowed}. Prove §6.5: cleanup runs at most once; Borrowed cleanup is a no-op; Delivered never cleans up. Encode use-on-non-Live as a type error (linear-style handle) so the finalizer backstop is dead code for in-language uses (doc §9.7).
tasks.output: Core/Resource.lean created and fully green (lake env lean exit 0; `lake build Core` succeeds). Pure IO-free model of the Haskell Resource.hs ownership protocol: ResourceState (live/delivered/released/releaseFailed) × Provenance (owned/borrowed), releaseStep/transferStep/Op/run (operation sequences with a cleanup-run counter), linear-style `use r h f` requiring h : r.state = live so non-Live use is a type error. §6.5 machine-checked: run_cleanup_at_most_once (count ≤ 1 over any op sequence, via run_no_clean_of_not_live invariant), releaseStep/run_borrowed_never_cleans (Borrowed cleanup no-op, stays borrowed), releaseStep_delivered_noop + run_delivered_never_cleans (Delivered never cleans up). §9.7: use_after_release_unrepresentable + withScope_owned_not_live + finalizer_backstop_dead (after the lexical bracket, no `use` is typeable, so the GC finalizer backstop is dead code for in-language uses); withScope_borrowed_noop and withScope_owned_cleans_once included. Core.lean now imports Core.Resource.

tasks.output: Phase 2 complete. tasks.subject: Phase 3: Core/Protocol session machine + §6.3 refinement
tasks.description: Port the mirror session protocol to Core/Protocol.lean per §5.3: inductive Phase (idle|validating|generating|ready|stepping|exploring|done, extended with async-job flows), phase-indexed Session structure, and `def step : Session p → ClientMessage → Except ProtocolError (Σ p', Session p' × List MirrorMessage)` so illegal orderings are unrepresentable (no report_state accepted in idle; first-message Register* rule holds by construction). Encode specs/MirrorProtocol.tla's mirror-side transition relation as an inductive predicate TlaStep and prove §6.3: (1) safety refinement — every Core.step transition corresponds to a TlaStep modulo the stated async-job/explorer extensions; (2) no unsolicited output — in each phase the emittable MirrorMessage constructors are exactly the spec'd set.
tasks.output: Core/Protocol.lean (1265 lines) written and machine-checked green (`lake env lean Core/Protocol.lean` exit 0; `lake build Core` ✔, import added to Core.lean). Contents: Phase (7 TLA+ Ms phases + validatingAsync/generatingAsync async extensions), Flow, tag-abstract ClientMessage/MirrorMessage, ProtocolError, phase-indexed Session p (phantom index, flow payload), Oracles (injected validation outcome, reportState carries matches/lastStep bits like TLA report_matches), step : Session p → ClientMessage → Except ProtocolError (Σ p', Session p' × List MirrorMessage) folding each TLA+ MirrorRecv/MirrorSend pair. Ordering theorems by construction: step_idle_iff_registration (first-message rule), step_idle_reportState (no reportState in idle, by rfl), step_stepping_iff_reportState, step_done_rejects. §6.3: TlaState + inductive TlaStep (25 ctors: 18 spec actions named after specs/MirrorProtocol.tla + 6 explicitly-marked ext* async-job extension steps) + TlaSteps closure; theorem step_refines_tla (every successful step = 1-3 TLA steps from embed s to target with exactly the emitted queue, async flows via ext ctors); theorem no_unsolicited_output (emitted ⊆ AllowedOutputs p, protocolError never emitted) + allowed_outputs_attainable (exactness: every allowed tag has a witness). Note: proving no_unsolicited_output exposed that AllowedOutputs for idle must include explorerReady (registerExploreSession emits it) — table now includes it.

tasks.subject: Phase 4: Core/Jobs + §6.4 theorems
tasks.description: Port Protocol.AsyncJobs to Core/Jobs.lean: JobId/JobKind/JobPhase/JobOutcome vocabulary and the async job state machine. Prove §6.4: terminal phases (JobDone/JobFailed/JobCancelled) are absorbing; JobUnknown is returned exactly for ids never submitted or evicted; outcome congruence — a completed ValidateJob's JobOutcome payload equals what the synchronous RegisterValidate flow replies (SpecValidated/RegisterError), stated as observational equality of the two pure machines on identical inputs; bound enforcement — validate bounds outside [1, maxValidateBound = 100] are rejected in async and sync paths alike.
tasks.output: Core/Jobs.lean written (261 lines, no sorry) and green: lake build Core.Jobs ✔ and full lake build ✔ (import added to Core.lean). Vocabulary ported from Haskell Protocol.Core/AsyncJobs@3496251: JobId, JobKind, JobPhase (wire), StoredPhase (JobPhase minus jobUnknown — the store can never hold an unknown job, which makes the JobUnknown theorem exactly true), ValidateResult (valid/invalid split abstractly), JobOutcome, JobEntry, JobEvent, JobStore (list + job-<n> counter), hand-rolled lookupJob, evict, maxValidateBound=100, checkBound, SubmitError, submitValidateJob, registerValidateSync (delegates to Core.step). §6.4 theorems, all machine-checked: (1) terminal_absorbing + isTerminal_of_transition (JobDone/JobFailed/JobCancelled absorbing); (2) queryJobPhase_unknown_iff (JobUnknown iff id not in store) + evicted_becomes_unknown + submitted_not_unknown; (3) outcome_congruence (outcomeTag (oracleValidateOutcome ok) = syncValidateReplyTag ok for all ok — observational equality of async completion and the synchronous RegisterValidate reply via Core.step) + async_completion (completed validate job ends done+terminal with exactly that outcome); (4) bounds_rejected_both_paths + bounds_accepted_submit (bounds outside [1,100] rejected in async submit and sync registerValidate alike, before any state change).
